---
title: Initial Self-Assessment
---

I want you to take a few minutes to answer the following questions:

* Why did you decide to take this class?
* What do you hope to get out of this class?
* What aspect of the class are you most excited about? Most worried about?
* Write a statement about the actions that you will take to help our class to be a productive learning environment, for yourself and for the rest of the students.
